what: The proposed `.done` barrier is inserted after `-s` status classification, so it cannot fix voters that are marked failed before the wait completes
scenario_or_breakage: If a voter output is still empty or not visible when lines 199-210 run, then the later wait may observe `.done` and the output may become non-empty, but `VOTER_N_STATUS` remains `failed` and parse-rate/tally skip it
suggested_fix: Move the wait barrier before the `[[ -s "$VOTER_*_PATH" ]] || VOTER_*_STATUS="failed"` checks, or recompute all size-based statuses after the wait

what: The proposed delayed `.done` test cannot exercise the intended Voter 1 race by only changing the `claude` stub
scenario_or_breakage: `launch-claude-review.sh` writes `${OUTPUT}.done` synchronously after the subprocess returns, and `dispatch-code-voters.sh` also backfills it at line 113, so a child `claude` stub cannot reliably delay the sentinel after output; the regression can pass without proving the new barrier works
suggested_fix: Test the barrier by shim-driving the dispatcher boundary instead, for example set `CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT` to a fixture whose `scripts/dispatch-with-waterfall.sh` returns an output path before a background writer creates `<path>.done`, then assert `dispatch-code-voters.sh` waits before classification and parse-rate

what: The plan requires stdin redirection in all three spawn branches, but the listed tests only exercise it indirectly through voter dispatch
scenario_or_breakage: The default Codex voter path can pass while `--capture-stdout` or `--capture-stdout-only` Codex launches still inherit stdin, leaving implementer/retry/coder paths exposed to the same stdin-close failure
suggested_fix: Add `scripts/test-run-external-agent.sh` to the modified files and include direct stdin-probe cases for default, `--capture-stdout`, and `--capture-stdout-only` with `--tool codex`, plus a non-Codex control preserving current behavior
